reviews.text: ​Already on my second tube and I couldn’t be happier! Perfect for combination skin with large pores and a greasy T-zone. It evens out my skin tone so nicely and keeps breakouts at bay without harsh flaking or dryness. A total staple in my skincare routine now!
reviews.zh: 已經用緊第二枝，開心到不得了！啱晒混合性肌、毛孔粗大同 T 字位油笠嘅皮膚。均勻膚色效果好好，仲可以預防爆瘡，又唔會有甩皮或者乾燥嘅問題。已經成為我護膚 routine 必備嘅一員！

reviews.text: I’m really impressed with this retinol cream! It has a smooth, comfortable texture that feels gentle on the skin while providing effective care. My skin feels softer, smoother, and more refined after using it. I love how it helps improve the overall appearance of my skin without feeling heavy or irritating. A beautiful addition to my nighttime skincare routine.
reviews.zh: 我對呢枝 retinol 霜真係好滿意！質地滑順舒服，搽喺皮膚上好溫和，同時做到有效護理。用完之後皮膚感覺更柔軟、更滑、更細緻。佢幫助改善整體膚質，又唔會覺得厚重或者刺激，真係好正。已經加入我晚間護膚 routine。

reviews.text: I am so happy with this purchase! This retinol is extremely delicate and perfect for my combination skin that leans oily. I struggle with enlarged pores and applying this every other day has been a wonderful addition to my routine. It’s gentle, absorbs well and thankfully has a very mild scent. I’m definitely buying it again, though I really wish it lasted longer the 20ml tube runs out so fast.
reviews.zh: 今次買得好滿意！呢隻 retinol 好溫和，啱晒我偏油嘅混合性肌。我有毛孔粗大嘅問題，隔日用一次已經係 routine 嘅一大助力。佢好溫和，吸收得快，味道亦都好淡，一定會再回購，不過真係希望可以耐用啲，20ml 嘅枝裝真係好快用晒。

reviews.text: When you first open the product using the cap a LOT will come out and that seems like a waist of product. I would advise to use a push pin to make a small opening instead.
reviews.zh: 第一次用個蓋整開枝嘢嘅時候會爆出好多，似係好嘥產品。建議用返圖釘拮開個細啲嘅出口。

reviews.text: You don’t need high percentage retinol unless a deem says so, and you don’t need retinol in your teens and twenties. This per my derm due it its gentle formula is the perfect first retinol for my 30s. And a little goes a long way. Last step before moisturizer. Very gentle. No break outs. Great for sensitive skin.
reviews.zh: 除非醫生話你需要，否則唔需要高濃度 retinol，十幾廿歲亦都唔需要用 retinol。呢隻係我皮膚科醫生推薦嘅，因為佢嘅配方溫和，啱晒我 30 歲第一次用 retinol。而且好襟用，唔使好多。最後一步用完先上面霜。非常溫和。冇爆瘡。啱晒敏感肌。

reviews.text: I’ve been using this cream for 3 months now to treat dark spots and I have noticed some good results! They absorb really well but I use small amounts at a time to avoid irritation. Also this product explodes out the bottle which makes it harder to keep it clean.
reviews.zh: 用咗呢枝 cream 3 個月去處理色斑，見到啲唔錯嘅效果！吸收得好快，不過我每次都用少量避免刺激。而且呢枝嘢會從樽口爆出嚟，比較難保持乾淨。

reviews.text:
I used this one night and it was absorbed very quickly. The next day my face was a little dry, so I just applied extra moisturizer. I need to use it more often to see a reduction in the lines around my mouth. 
My skin felt softer and more supple for sure
reviews.zh:
我用咗一個晚，吸收得好快。第二日塊面有少少乾，所以我就額外搽多啲面霜。要再勤啲用先睇到嘴邊嘅細紋有冇減少。
不過皮膚明顯感覺更柔軟、更飽滿。

reviews.text: Excellent beginner retinol! I have had some issues with retinols being too harsh for my sensitive skin, but this one is great and doesn't make my skin flakey or irritated at all. I have also noticed a difference in my overall tone and texture of my skin. My face is much smoother than before I used it, and just looks bit firmer and nicer overall. I only use this every other night, but I have still seen good results. I would recommend this to anyone who wants to try adding a retinol into their routine, especially if they have more sensitive skin.
reviews.zh: 非常適合初學者嘅視黃醇！我之前用過嘅視黃醇對我嘅敏感肌嚟講太刺激，但呢隻完全唔會，皮膚又唔會甩皮又唔會敏感。我仲留意到整體膚色同膚質都有改善，塊面比起用之前滑咗好多，望落都更緊緻更好睇。我只係隔晚用一次，但已經見到唔錯嘅效果。如果你想試吓加入視黃醇落護膚程序，特別係敏感肌嘅人，我會推薦呢隻。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
